# Quickwell

> Quickwell is a studio of small, single-purpose web tools. Everyday consumer tools include a fridge-to-dinner helper, a restaurant-dish copycat, a weekly meal planner, a service-quote fairness check, an on-device photo timestamp-and-fingerprint for disputes, a returns-and-warranty tracker, a medicine-label double-dose checker, a contract red-flag scanner, a scam-message checker, a bill-and-letter action extractor, a bank-export subscription and fee finder, a fall-risk screening tool, daily brain games, a lost-phone plan, and a commodity-price desk. Business and trucking tools include a broker rate confirmation checker, an FMCSA new entrant audit self-check and kit, an EUDR plot file checker (English, French and Spanish), a Texas drilling permit watcher and a year-end vendor check (1099 list, renewals and price increases). Each tool has plain-English reference pages that explain the rules it checks, with official sources linked on every page. Two reference sections help small businesses manage auto-renewals, vendor price increases and recurring charges, and apply the 2026 Form 1099 rules ($2,000 threshold, exclusions, deadlines).

All tools run in the browser; files and text people check are not uploaded. Reference pages are educational, not legal advice, and list the date their sources were checked.

## Tools

- [What's for Dinner?](https://quickwell.app/dinner/): Tap what's in your fridge and get three dinners you can make tonight, ranked make-now vs. need-one-thing, plus the one thing to grab. Runs in the browser; nothing is uploaded. Free; Quickwell Plus adds a Use-It-Up rescue, a 4-dinner plan and a grocery list.
- [Copycat Kitchen](https://quickwell.app/copycat/): Had a dish out and want to make it at home? Tell it the cuisine, dish, protein and flavors and it reverse-engineers a close home recipe plus the restaurant trick behind it. The photo you add stays on your device; no fake photo recognition. Free; Plus saves a cookbook.
- [Weekly Kitchen](https://quickwell.app/kitchen/): Save your pantry once (on the device) and get tonight's dinner ideas free; Quickwell Plus plans a week of varied dinners, prioritizes what's about to spoil, and makes one grocery list.
- [Fair Price](https://quickwell.app/fair-price/): Paste a service estimate (auto repair, contractor, dental, vet, movers, HVAC) and get the padding red-flags, what a fair quote should include, and the questions to ask. It never invents a market price. Free; Plus compares two quotes and drafts a negotiation message. Information, not financial advice.
- [Proof](https://quickwell.app/proof/): Add a photo and get an on-device timestamp and SHA-256 fingerprint you keep, so you can later show the photo wasn't altered (move-outs, damage, delivered-broken, gig work). A record you keep, not legal proof by itself. Free; Plus keeps a log and a printable report.
- [Keep the Receipt](https://quickwell.app/keep-the-receipt/): Log a purchase and it tracks the return window and warranty, sorts by what's closing soonest, and flags returns due in a few days. Stays on the device. Free; Plus attaches receipt photos and a printable list.
- [Double Dose](https://quickwell.app/double-dose/): Enter the active ingredients off your medicine labels and it flags when two products share one, so you don't double up by accident. Label-driven, on the device. Information, not medical advice. Free; Plus adds a printable list for a pharmacist.
- [Before You Sign](https://quickwell.app/before-you-sign/): Paste any contract (lease, loan, gym, phone, medical consent, freelance deal) and see the clauses that cost you, each with a line to ask for a fix. Runs in the browser; nothing is uploaded. Not legal advice.
- [Roadside Medical SOS Kit](https://quickwell.app/roadside-sos/): Build a printable glovebox/visor medical card (conditions, meds, blood type, contacts, CDL/DOT for truckers), a step-by-step guide to turn on the phone's own hands-free SOS and crash detection, a BE FAST stroke card, and a one-tap screen that shows your live GPS with a dispatcher script. On the device; nothing is uploaded. It does not place the call; not medical advice. Free.
- [Vigless](https://quickwell.app/vigless/): Track the sports bets you actually placed and see your real ROI, win rate, record and which bet types lose you money, with loss-chasing warnings and responsible-gambling resources. Runs in the browser; nothing is uploaded. Takes no wagers and connects to no sportsbook; 21+; not betting advice. Free.
- [Tradepath](https://quickwell.app/tradepath/): Drop a broker CSV (or log trades by hand) and see your real profit/loss, win rate, profit factor and which asset class leaks money, for stocks, crypto and commodities. Runs in the browser; nothing is uploaded. Never executes trades or connects to a brokerage; not investment advice. Free.
- [Rate Con Checker](https://quickwell.app/rate-con-checker/): Paste a trucking broker rate confirmation; 20 checks (detention, TONU, layover, lumper, fines, setoff, payment terms, broker identity and more) give a grade and a ready-to-send fix request. Runs in the browser; nothing is uploaded. 3 free checks a day; Pro is $9/month or $79/year.
- [Spare Key](https://quickwell.app/spare-key/): A private lost-phone and family legacy plan for everyday people: tap through the accounts you use (never type a password) to get a Lockout Score, a fix list, a printable Lost-Phone Sheet and an encrypted family handoff file. Free for one person; Family Pack $4.99 one-time. Everything stays on the device.
- [Year-End Vendor Check](https://quickwell.app/vendor-check/): Upload a 2026 bank, card, QuickBooks or Xero export and see which vendors likely need a Form 1099 under the $2,000 threshold for payments after Dec 31, 2025 (26 U.S.C. 6041), who is near the line, who is probably excluded (card payments, most corporations) and the W-9s to collect, plus every recurring charge, renewal, price increase and contract cancel-by date. Free scan; $19 Owner Pack or $59 Bookkeeper Pack, one-time. Runs in the browser; nothing is uploaded. Not tax advice.
- [New Authority Audit Kit](https://quickwell.app/audit-kit/): Free self-check against the 16 violations that automatically fail an FMCSA new entrant safety audit (49 CFR 385.321(b)), then an optional $39 one-time kit that fills in driver files, drug and alcohol program documents, maintenance files and an audit binder. Runs in the browser. A free one-page printable of the 16 rules is at /audit-kit/16-rules-printable/.
- [EUDR Plot File Checker](https://quickwell.app/plot-file-checker/): Free checker for farm plot geolocation files (GeoJSON, KML, CSV, WKT) under the EU Deforestation Regulation; flags the EU Information System's file rules and fixes the safe ones. English, French and Spanish. Runs in the browser.
- [Permit Watch (Texas)](https://quickwell.app/permit-watch/): Free list of new Texas drilling permits by county from the Railroad Commission of Texas daily permit file, with filters and a free RSS feed per county. First data load pending.
- [WorldSource Commodity Desk](https://quickwell.app/commodities/): Commodity prices only (no stocks): metals, energy, grains and softs, fertilizers, ECB reference currency rates and the U.S. Treasury yield curve, from free official sources (World Bank Pink Sheet monthly averages, EIA spot prices via FRED, ECB, U.S. Treasury), each number labeled with source, date and frequency. A daily brief that is the same for every reader, a private holdings tracker in any currency (stored on the device), and a guide to checking that a dealer or broker is licensed. Not investment advice; it never holds funds or executes trades. Free board, brief and 3 holdings; Desk plan $2.99/month or $24.99/year, also in Quickwell Plus.
- [Quickwell Saver](https://quickwell.app/saver/): Reads your own bank or card export (CSV, or pasted statement text) in the browser and finds every subscription and recurring bill, price increases, double charges, free trials that turned paid, and bank fees, with a yearly total. Nothing is uploaded and it never asks for a bank login. Free scan; the Saver plan ($2.99/month or $24.99/year, also in Quickwell Plus) adds cancellation, price push-back, refund and fee-reversal letters, cancel-by calendar reminders and a running saved-per-year record. Not financial or legal advice.
- [Quickwell Pilot](https://quickwell.app/pilot/): Paste the text of any letter, bill, email or notice (or a text PDF; photos are read on the device where supported) and it pulls out what is needed from you: the action, the deadline, the amount, who it is from and how to contact them, with a confidence on each field. It makes a checklist, calendar reminders (7 days and 1 day before) and reply drafts (extension, payment confirmation, dispute, cancel, reschedule) in English and Spanish. Nothing is uploaded. Free for 3 saved items; the Pilot plan ($2.99/month or $24.99/year, also in Quickwell Plus) adds unlimited items, a what-is-due timeline and a weekly summary. Not legal advice.
- [Quickwell Shield](https://quickwell.app/shield/): Paste any text message, email, DM, voicemail transcript or link and it checks it on the device for common scam warning signs (pressure, secrecy, impersonation, gift-card/crypto/wire payment, code or password requests, look-alike and punycode links, shorteners), highlights the exact words behind each sign, explains it in plain words and gives safe next steps. It never says a message is safe; at most "no common warning signs found". Free and unlimited; the Family plan ($2.99/month or $24.99/year, also in Quickwell Plus) adds a family code-word kit, family scam-alert cards and a private check history. English and Spanish.
- [Quickwell Plus](https://quickwell.app/plus/): One subscription ($4.99/month or $39/year; local-currency prices where available) that unlocks the paid features of every Quickwell everyday tool: Footsure Family, Brain Pass, the Spare Key Family Pack, and each new consumer tool as it launches. Business tools are sold separately.
- [Footsure](https://quickwell.app/footsure/): Runs the three CDC STEADI fall-risk screening tests (30-second chair stand, 4-stage balance, Timed Up and Go) with a phone and a helper, and compares each result with the CDC cutoffs from the official 2017 forms. Optional on-device camera counting (beta); the video never leaves the phone. Free checks; Family plan $2.99/month or $24.99/year (or Quickwell Plus) adds monthly re-checks, a trend chart, encrypted family sharing and a printable summary. General wellness, not a medical device or diagnosis.
- [Quickwell Play (Echo, Swift, Linkr)](https://quickwell.app/play/): Three short daily browser games: Echo (repeat growing tile sequences; memory), Swift (fast attention challenges with combo multipliers; focus) and Linkr (draw a path whose numbers add up to a target; logic). A free daily challenge in each, the same for everyone, plus 3 free practice runs a day; Brain Pass ($2.99/month, $19.99/year or $29.99 once) adds unlimited practice, all difficulties and extra modes. Installable, works offline, progress stays on the device. The games train the skills they practise; no claim that they raise general intelligence.

## Reference pages

- [Rate con glossary](https://quickwell.app/learn/rate-con/): Plain-English definitions of rate confirmation terms: detention, TONU, layover, lumper, setoff, quick pay, factoring and NOA, double brokering, claims and more, with what to ask a broker before you sign. (24 pages)
- [New entrant audit](https://quickwell.app/learn/new-entrant-audit/): Every automatic-fail violation in the FMCSA new entrant safety audit (49 CFR 385.321(b)), one page each: what the rule says, the records involved, how to fix it, and the audit timeline. (16 pages)
- [EUDR plot file errors](https://quickwell.app/learn/eudr/): The common reasons an EUDR geolocation (GeoJSON) file is rejected by the EU Information System: swapped coordinates, decimals, open or self-crossing polygons, holes, points over 4 ha, file size, property names. One page each. (11 pages)
- [Erreurs de fichiers RDUE (French)](https://quickwell.app/fr/learn/eudr/): Pourquoi un fichier de géolocalisation RDUE (GeoJSON) est refusé par le Système d'information de l'UE : coordonnées inversées, décimales, polygones ouverts ou croisés, trous, points de plus de 4 ha, taille, noms de propriétés. (11 pages)
- [Texas RRC districts](https://quickwell.app/learn/texas-drilling-permits/): All 13 Railroad Commission of Texas oil and gas districts (01–10, 6E, 7B, 7C, 8A): the counties in each, district offices, major formations, recent permit counts and how to watch new drilling permits. (13 pages)
- [Business costs](https://quickwell.app/learn/business-costs/): Small-business guides: find auto-renewal deadlines in contracts, push back on vendor price increases, and spot recurring and duplicate charges. (3 pages)
- [1099 reporting](https://quickwell.app/learn/1099/): The new $2,000 Form 1099 threshold for 2026 payments, who is excluded (card payments, most corporations) and the deadlines in early 2027. (3 pages)
- [Fall-risk tests explained](https://quickwell.app/learn/fall-risk-tests/): How the CDC STEADI 30-second chair stand, 4-stage balance test and Timed Up and Go work, the cutoffs on the 2017 forms, and how to do them safely.
- [Pruebas de riesgo de caídas (Spanish)](https://quickwell.app/es/learn/fall-risk-tests/): Cómo funcionan las tres pruebas STEADI de los CDC (silla de 30 segundos, equilibrio en 4 posiciones y Timed Up and Go) y sus valores de corte.
- [Guides](https://quickwell.app/guides/): Longer how-to guides for the same audiences.

## Optional

- [Full page list](https://quickwell.app/llms-full.txt): every reference page with its one-line summary.
